title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Ready for You
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official release of the powerful Spyglass tool, now fully available to empower your insights and streamline your workflow.

title: Streamlined File Management in Your Editor
summary: Enjoy powerful new controls for managing and displaying files directly within your editor, allowing you to seamlessly upload, remove, and download attached media with ease.

title: Discover Our Dynamic Product Roadmap!
summary: Our brand new public roadmap provides full transparency into our progress, showcasing recently completed features, upcoming additions, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more intuitive experience with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now larger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Collaborate seamlessly with your team in real-time, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

title: Seamless Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it easier to discover and collaborate on shared items, empowering you to connect and achieve more with your network.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: We are excited to announce that Noeko is now open source, empowering you with maximum control and direct involvement in our project's future while ensuring complete transparency.

title: Worldwide Language Accessibility
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, connecting our global community.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Upgrades
summary: Transform your experience with an exciting array of new themes and significant visual improvements designed to offer a more personalized and vibrant interface.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your knowledge base with powerful new filtering and sharing options, transforming your Constellation view into an indispensable tool for discovery and organization.

title: Precision Search and Curated Collections
summary: Refine your search with powerful new filtering and sorting options, then save your customized results as personal collections for effortless access to tailored information.

title: Smarter Note Structuring
summary: Experience a seamless flow of ideas with new interactive content views and flexible display options that empower you to organize your notes exactly as you think.

title: Elevate Your Noeko Experience: Self-Hosted & Premium Features
summary: Experience ultimate control and enhanced capabilities with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting option and new premium plans tailored for every user.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Experience a more delightful welcome with perfectly timed greetings on your homepage, now accurately reflecting the time of day.

title: Enhanced Tag Management Actions
summary: Streamline your workflow by directly unapplying tags, deleting, and viewing items from your tag lists, making organization more efficient and intuitive than ever.

title: Expand Your Content Sources
summary: Get ready to seamlessly integrate and interact with a diverse range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to consolidate all your valuable insights in one place.
